Name: Mushroom Tree Growth Re-texture
Author: burtron
Description:
[size=3]A simple re-texture for the growth stages of the mushroom tree so that it doesn't look like a normal sapling.

[b][color=#cc0000]Honestly, I have no idea if the growth stages are even used.[/color][/b] There are a lot conflicting posts about it when searching.
I didn't have any on my farm (summer) when I made this, so I changed one of the other trees into it for the screenshots.

To install, copy the "Content" folder into your game directory and replace "mushroom_tree.xnb" when prompted. (I'd recommend copying the original file to another folder in case you want to uninstall the new texture.)[/size]

Downloads.Description: Extract "Content" folder to your main directory!

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
